articleTitle: Adaptive golf-optimized multi-layer perceptron framework for energy-efficient geographic routing and extended network lifetime in MANETs.
takeaways: This study is about computer network optimization, not health-related research, so no health takeaways can be extracted
The research focuses on mobile ad-hoc networks (MANETs) and routing algorithms, which has no direct application to human health or wellness
While the study shows technical improvements like 18-25% better network lifetime and 20-27% reduced energy consumption, these relate to computer systems, not biological or health outcomes
